Highest verified mouth-to-visible-upper-teeth ratios in the screened sample

20 qualified people · 60 qualifying occasions. Four qualifications retained from V2; 16 completed in this continuation. This is a screened sample, not a population-wide ranking.

R = M/T. M is the source-horizontal distance between inner oral-opening terminations; T spans all identifiable visible upper enamel, including shaded posterior teeth. Lower enamel, lips, gums and darkness are excluded. Occupancy =100T/M; lateral fraction =100(1−T/M), a linear width fraction. One quality-selected social/posed smile per independent occasion; equal weights; median over at least three occasions in a documented period.

Point estimates determine table order. Landmark bounds overlap substantially, so this order is provisional. Bounds are worst-case placement intervals, not statistical confidence intervals. The rank range below uses only non-overlapping bounded medians; it is neither a probability nor an all-world rank. Observed min/max across smiles is a separate source of variability.

Original-source mouths near200px are preferred. Explicit publicly provided derivatives and smaller mouths can qualify only when upper enamel identity is traceable; their dimensions and precision downgrades remain visible. Enlargement adds no source detail. Reviews and repeats are by the same system; no independent human review or guaranteed blinded validation is claimed. No facial diagnosis is inferred.

Coverage and process audit

V2 documented240 American adults screened and43 people with selected quantitative records. This continuation revisited existing candidates, so it adds0 new distinct people to that screening count. Current numeric ledger: 88 selected/diagnostic frame records for 87 distinct person/source-page photographs, including 32 new photographs and 1 upgraded existing-photo frame. Old and upgraded frames of Mikaela2016 receive only one scored occasion. Branch photo-review ledgers describe actual visual screening separately from metadata-only discoveries; they must not be summed as new people.

The revised workflow builds a dated event inventory per person, expands public captioned source coverage, selects suitable images before ratios, completes three independent occasions, checks source pixels and shaded upper posterior endpoints, repeats placements and records any adjudication. Old numeric leads remain auditable. This prevents easy candidates being abandoned after a single archive search or a single unusually high smile.

The accompanying workbook has linked formulas; CSV and JSON retain exact coordinates, intervals, hashes, source pages and source dimensions. Audit archive retains eligibility, screening and placement records. Rights-reserved images/crops are omitted; permitted representative crops include attribution and license. Source photo links remain usable.
